name: smart-campus-ai
description: SmartCampus AI — The Future of Intelligent Education

scripts.dev:all: (npm run docker:dev || echo "Docker not running or not found. Starting servers locally...") && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd api && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd api && npm run lint && cd ../web && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd api && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit
